profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Asana
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer, urban choreo dancer, hobby enthusiast, and content creator.

My love for programming has always revolved around its magic to change the course of people’s lives. Whether the scale is large or small, I believe that technology can be used to enhance everyday patterns and to positively shape the direction we take. I am particularly interested in achieving this through designing beautiful interfaces, producing authentic content, and creating seamless user experiences.

www.mattminwoolee.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product engineer on the Authorization / Access Control team

- Developing Asana's Roles Based Access Control System (RBAC).
- Bringing secure and consistent authorization solutions

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend Tech Lead for Trends, Style Tags, and Feed Revamp

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Backend Tech Lead for Recommendation pipeline (Just Picked for You), Fraud/Spam Moderation

positions.title: Software Engineering Instructor
positions.description:
» Taught and mentored 100+ aspiring software engineers in Javascript fundamentals, algorithms, data structures, and web development
» Provided one-on-one remediation through office hours and debugging support for students; resolved 50+ tickets weekly
» Hosted lectures on higher thinking concepts (i.e. front-end, back-end, databases, system design, etc)

positions.title: Lab Technician
positions.description:
» Expedited data collection process by 40% by constructing MATLAB program to automate hypercision titration measurements
» Provided troubleshooting, engineering, and technical support as required; identified temperature fluctuations in lab freezers that are used to store bulk reagents and tissue samples
» Prevented 500+ tissue sample losses by identifying temperature fluctuations in lab freezers and led the installation of new ones

positions.title: Semiconductors Research Assistant
positions.description:
» Implemented studies on micro/nanostructured inorganic materials and their printed assembly for applications in energy harvesting, electronics, optoelectronics, and sensor technologies with Yoon group
» Supported fellow PhD student peers with research focused on advancing the fabrication of perovskite material solar cells through solution-based method and advanced spin coating; resulted in 12.5% efficiency with a 20% increase from previous perovskite solar cell performance

educations.fieldOfStudy: Chemical Engineering with an emphasis in Sustainable Energy
